The component that chooses gallery vs ChartFilter is not shown, so I can't confirm it renders the gallery from this flag.

The dropdown-vs-gallery switch is in an unseen component. The author says it falls back to ChartFilter when `canShowAlternatives` is false, which would make the two mutually exclusive, but that is only a claim.
In edit mode, `editMode` was true before, so removing `!!editMode &&` leaves the same conditions. Options, `canSelectCharts` and the listeners are untouched.

`canSelectCharts = canShowAlternatives && !insightDataLoading` is now true in view mode. The selection listener and how it updates the query are not shown, so I can't confirm it takes the same path or takes effect in view mode.

`isEditableSurface` still requires `!embedded && !inSharedMode && !isInDashboardContext && canEditInsight && !editingDisabledReason`, and `canShowAlternatives` requires it. The author's claim that users without permission see a disabled gallery is wrong, since `canShowAlternatives` is false for them. That still satisfies the criterion, because the gallery is not offered.
`canShowAlternatives` still requires `featureFlags[PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES] && isEditableSurface && isTrends && !!query && !!trendsSource`. Only the editMode term was removed.

The popover, `openGallery` and `closeGallery` logic is unchanged, and `openGallery` closes when `!canSelectCharts`. The anchored popover rendering is not in the diff, so I can't confirm it appears in view mode.

result:
The chart type gallery now shows in view mode on the insight page, and the plain dropdown no longer appears there. I haven't run the tests or the app, so this is untested.

The gate is `isEditableSurface` in `chartAlternativesLogic.ts`, which `canShowAlternatives` depends on. It required `editMode`, so view mode fell back to `ChartFilter`, the dropdown. I removed that requirement.

The other conditions are unchanged. The gallery still needs the feature flag and a trends insight. It still doesn't show on embedded, shared or dashboard surfaces, so those keep the dropdown. In edit mode nothing changes.

Viewers who lack edit permission see the gallery button disabled with the existing reason (`selectionDisabledReason`). Viewers who can edit can pick a chart type without entering edit mode, as they could with the dropdown before.

I added a test in `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` that renders the component without `editMode` and checks the gallery trigger appears.
